schema.name: bpay_next_treatment_approval_distinct_check
schema.definition: CHECK (((payment_treatment_approval_revision_id IS NULL) OR ((payment_treatment_approval_revision_id <> id) AND (source_event_id IS NULL))))

schema.name: bpay_next_treatment_approval_revision_fk
schema.definition: FOREIGN KEY (work_id, payment_treatment_approval_revision_id) REFERENCES private.bpay_next_work_revision(work_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

checks.name: bpay_next_workbench_command_request_size_ck
checks.definition:
CHECK (((jsonb_typeof(request_body) = 'object'::text) AND (octet_length((request_body)::text) <=
CASE
    WHEN (action = 'RETRY_WORK_JOB'::text) THEN 4096
    ELSE 32768
END)))

checks.name: bpay_next_workbench_command_result_size_ck
checks.definition:
CHECK (((jsonb_typeof(result) = 'object'::text) AND (octet_length((result)::text) <=
CASE
    WHEN (action = 'RETRY_WORK_JOB'::text) THEN 8192
    ELSE 65536
END)))

checks.name: bpay_next_workbench_command_variant_ck
checks.definition:
CHECK (((((action = 'RETRY_WORK_JOB'::text) AND (job_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((action = ANY (ARRAY['RESOLUTION_SAVE'::text, 'RESOLUTION_CLEAR'::text])) AND (job_id IS NULL) AND (retry_run_worker_id IS NULL) AND (retry_input_job_id IS NULL) AND (retry_captured_revision IS NULL) AND (retry_expected_revision IS NULL) AND (retry_target_revision IS NULL) AND ((result ->> 'action'::text) = action) AND
CASE
    WHEN ((jsonb_typeof((request_body -> 'works'::text)) = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((result -> 'works'::text)) = 'array'::text)) THEN (((jsonb_array_length((request_body -> 'works'::text)) >= 1) AND (jsonb_array_length((request_body -> 'works'::text)) <= 100)) AND (jsonb_array_length((result -> 'works'::text)) = jsonb_array_length((request_body -> 'works'::text))) AND
    CASE
        WHEN (jsonb_array_length((request_body -> 'works'::text)) = 1) THEN ((work_id IS NOT NULL) AND ((request_body #>> '{works,0,work_id}'::text[]) = (work_id)::text) AND ((result #>> '{works,0,work_id}'::text[]) = (work_id)::text))
        ELSE (work_id IS NULL)
    END)
    ELSE false
END)) IS TRUE))

checks.name: bpay_next_workbench_retry_execution_ck
checks.definition: CHECK ((((retry_run_worker_id IS NULL) AND (retry_input_job_id IS NULL) AND (retry_captured_revision IS NULL) AND (retry_expected_revision IS NULL) AND (retry_target_revision IS NULL)) OR ((num_nonnulls(retry_run_worker_id, retry_input_job_id, retry_captured_revision, retry_expected_revision, retry_target_revision) = 5) AND (retry_captured_revision > 0) AND (retry_expected_revision > 0) AND ((retry_target_revision)::numeric = ((retry_expected_revision)::numeric + (1)::numeric)) AND (retry_captured_revision <= retry_expected_revision))))

checks.name: bpay_next_workbench_retry_work_ck
checks.definition: CHECK (((action <> 'RETRY_WORK_JOB'::text) OR ((work_id IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT ((result ->> 'retry_kind'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM 'PREPARE'::text)))))
